description: Test file for the NFS volume plugin in Kubernetes, including support checks, access modes, volume mounting/unmounting, and handling of different server address formats.

methods.name: TestCanSupport
methods.description: Tests whether the NFS plugin supports specific volume configurations.

methods.name: TestGetAccessModes
methods.description: Verifies the access modes supported by the NFS plugin.

methods.name: TestRecycler
methods.description: Tests the recyclability of NFS volumes.

methods.name: doTestPlugin
methods.description: Performs mounting, unmounting, and device verification for an NFS volume.

methods.name: TestPluginVolume
methods.description: Tests mounting of a standard NFS volume with IPv4 address.

methods.name: TestIPV6VolumeSource
methods.description: Tests mounting of an NFS volume with an IPv6 address.

methods.name: TestIPV4VolumeSource
methods.description: Tests mounting of an NFS volume with an IPv4 address.

methods.name: TestPluginPersistentVolume
methods.description: Tests mounting of a persistent volume source with NFS.

methods.name: TestPersistentClaimReadOnlyFlag
methods.description: Verifies that the read-only flag is correctly set from persistent volume claims.
